blocks.text: Brokenness is the process by which the flesh is subdued so that meekness and humility can take root - {{mi 6:8|Micah 6:8}}, {{mt 11:29|Matthew 11:29}}, {{mt 18:4|Matthew 18:4}}. It means the crucifixion of the flesh and its hold over the inner man - {{gl 5:24|Galatians 5:24}}, {{rm 6:6|Romans 6:6}}, {{cl 3:12|Colossians 3:12}}.

An unbroken person is ruled by self and pride, the full manifestation of the works of the flesh - {{gl 5:19,gl 5:20,gl 5:21|Galatians 5:19-21}}. Breaking that hold of "self" must be a vital goal for every worker in the Lord's service.

items: A personal decision to subdue self - {{mt 18:4|Matthew 18:4}}, {{mt 20:26,mt 20:27|Matthew 20:26-27}}, {{ph 2:3|Philippians 2:3}}.
A life of humility - pride brings a person into direct confrontation with God - {{jm 4:6,jm 4:10|James 4:6, 10}}, {{mt 23:12|Matthew 23:12}}.

Fear and reverence for God - {{ps 111:10|Psalm 111:10}}, {{prv 1:7|Proverbs 1:7}}, {{prv 3:7|Proverbs 3:7}}, {{prv 8:13|Proverbs 8:13}}, the fear of God being the whole duty of man - {{ec 12:13|Ecclesiastes 12:13}}.

Surrendering yourself as an instrument of God for His purposes on earth - {{ez 22:30|Ezekiel 22:30}}, as a battle-axe, giant-killer, reformer, co-worker with Christ, or tool in the hand of the Holy Spirit.

blocks.text: "The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit" - {{ps 34:18|Psalm 34:18}}.
